intro: Join Bali Yoga School without leaving your home. Become a Yoga Alliance certified yoga teacher with our 200 Hour Self-Paced Online Yoga Teacher Training Course.

This is a self-paced online course which you can complete with time flexibility in the span of 3 to 6 months. This 200 hour self-paced online yoga teacher training course includes more than 150 hours of pre-recorded session videos that have been recorded in Rishikesh, India, and it also includes live zoom classes on Fridays and Saturdays. Even after you complete the course and receive a certificate, you will have access to the pre-recorded sessions and live zoom classes for one year.
You can join the course at any time, all you need is to write us an email, we will guide you to book the course.
